title: Thought Virus: Viral Misalignment via Subliminal Prompting in Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the increase in response frequency and log-probabilities for specific target concepts (e.g., animals like "lion") in agent outputs across a multi-agent system after introducing subliminally biased system prompts.

Evaluating agent accuracy and log-probability differences on the TruthfulQA multiple-choice benchmark to assess the tendency to reproduce common human misconceptions (deceitful answers) versus truthful answers after subliminal prompting.
